verdict.text: The change deletes `.github/workflows/hermes-interactive.yaml` and nothing else.
No tracked file outside `.loop/` refers to the workflow, its `toiminnot` action or its `@hermes` trigger.
`OLLAMA_API_KEY` is still used by `claude-ollama.yaml`, and the gates pass on my own stamp.
Staged diff (`git diff --cached --stat`): one file, 35 deletions, which match `main:.github/workflows/hermes-interactive.yaml`.
`git grep -i -e hermes-interactive -e hermes_interactive -e toiminnot -- ':!.loop'` finds nothing.
A filesystem grep that skips `.git`, `.loop`, `.terraform` and `.venv` also finds nothing.
The other `hermes` matches in `.okf/` and `docs/` are about the Hermes application job, not this workflow.
`docs/reference/github-actions.md` and the `.okf/` pages that name workflows list only `lab-auth-check`, `openviking-sync` and `claude-ollama`, so no doc now says anything false.
Plan premise: `openviking-sync.yaml` runs `./.github/actions/lab-auth` and `./.github/actions/openviking-sync` by local path, as the plan says.
Eval rows: r1 checks the index (a staged `git rm` empties `git ls-files`) and greps tracked files outside `.loop/`, which matches its `fails_when`.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: pass pre_commit, pass cli_tests, pass r1, pass r2, pass r3, "stamp green: 008578253da082b7fc3db3cf781b54b7fedc907736bf9b6f5b0c9ea861cddaa2".
In r1, `! git grep -q` would also pass if `git grep` failed with an error (exit 128) instead of finding no match.
That cannot happen in a valid worktree, so I am not raising it as a finding.
